# world-layout v0.3
#
# This file is machine-written and machine-parsed. Humans DO NOT edit this file.
# Humans provide natural-language inputs (NL lines). These lines are immutable.
#
# Agents extract two things from the cumulative NL inputs:
#   (1) PHENOMENA       — behaviors or patterns that unfold over time
#   (2) DIMENSIONALITIES — variables/properties that can change over time
#
# Only PHEN and DIM represent the agent’s current best interpretation of the
# world described by ALL NL lines so far. These interpretations MAY be revised.
# PHEN/DIM snapshots appear after each NL line to show the full world state
# after processing that NL; the most recent snapshot is the current state.
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   - NL is append-only, preserved exactly as written.
#   - After every NL line, append the full PHEN/DIM snapshot reflecting the
#     world state after incorporating that NL (including any changes it
#     triggered). Duplication is expected; clarity is prioritized over size.
#   - PHEN and DIM MAY be replaced, updated, or superseded as understanding improves.
#   - Agent must ensure PHEN/DIM always reflect the most accurate world model.
#
# Example:
#   NL "a ball is dropped"
#   -> agent may infer PHEN falling; DIM height, velocity, gravity_strength
#
#   NL "on planet earth"
#   -> agent must revise previous DIM gravity_strength=9.8 m/s^2
#      if it had assumed another value or left it unspecified.
#
# PHENOMENON (PHEN):
#   Something that happens or unfolds over time.
#   Examples: "ball falls", "trucks queue", "inventory oscillates"
#
# DIMENSIONALITY (DIM):
#   A variable whose value may change over time.
#   Examples: position, velocity, queue_length, gravitational_strength
#
# SYNTAX:
#   NL <verbatim user text>
#   PHEN <id> description="<text>"
#   DIM  <id> description="<text>"
#
# RULES:
#   - NL is append-only and preserved verbatim.
#   - Each PHEN/DIM snapshot collectively represents the world interpretation
#     after processing that NL; the latest snapshot is the current state.
#   - PHEN/DIM MUST be updated when new NL changes meaning or invalidates assumptions.
#   - Agents may modify or replace PHEN/DIM lines, but must not modify NL lines.
#   - PHEN/DIM lines should follow the NL that triggered their creation or change.
#   - PHEN/DIM ids must be lowercase snake_case.
#   - Descriptions must be quoted strings.
#
# End of header.
NL 11x11 maze
DIM maze_width description="width of the maze grid in cells; current value 11"
DIM maze_height description="height of the maze grid in cells; current value 11"
NL there's a traverser in the maze
PHEN traverser_navigation description="a traverser moves through the maze grid in search of a path"
DIM maze_width description="width of the maze grid in cells; current value 11"
DIM maze_height description="height of the maze grid in cells; current value 11"
DIM traverser_position description="current cell coordinates of the traverser; current value unspecified"
DIM traverser_motion_state description="whether the traverser is moving or idle; current value unspecified"
NL there can be multiple traversers
PHEN traverser_navigation description="traversers move through the maze grid in search of a path; multiple traversers may navigate concurrently"
DIM maze_width description="width of the maze grid in cells; current value 11"
DIM maze_height description="height of the maze grid in cells; current value 11"
DIM traverser_count description="number of traversers currently in the maze; current value unspecified"
DIM traverser_positions description="current cell coordinates of each traverser; current values unspecified"
DIM traverser_motion_states description="whether each traverser is moving or idle; current values unspecified"
NL each traverser has his own algorithm
PHEN traverser_navigation description="each traverser navigates the maze using its own algorithm while seeking paths concurrently"
DIM maze_width description="width of the maze grid in cells; current value 11"
DIM maze_height description="height of the maze grid in cells; current value 11"
DIM traverser_count description="number of traversers currently in the maze; current value unspecified"
DIM traverser_positions description="current cell coordinates of each traverser; current values unspecified"
DIM traverser_motion_states description="whether each traverser is moving or idle; current values unspecified"
DIM traverser_algorithms description="navigation algorithm assigned to each traverser; current values unspecified"
NL traversers do not know the map ahead of time
PHEN traverser_navigation description="each traverser navigates the maze using its own algorithm while exploring an unknown map to seek paths concurrently"
DIM maze_width description="width of the maze grid in cells; current value 11"
DIM maze_height description="height of the maze grid in cells; current value 11"
DIM traverser_count description="number of traversers currently in the maze; current value unspecified"
DIM traverser_positions description="current cell coordinates of each traverser; current values unspecified"
DIM traverser_motion_states description="whether each traverser is moving or idle; current values unspecified"
DIM traverser_algorithms description="navigation algorithm assigned to each traverser for exploring an unknown maze; current values unspecified"
DIM traverser_map_knowledge description="portion of the maze known to each traverser; current values start empty and update through exploration"
NL some traversers have a special ability, they can branch search, where they duplicate themselves and share a global memory of where they visited
PHEN traverser_navigation description="traversers navigate the maze using their own algorithms while exploring an unknown map; some can branch by duplicating and sharing a global visited memory to widen search concurrently"
DIM maze_width description="width of the maze grid in cells; current value 11"
DIM maze_height description="height of the maze grid in cells; current value 11"
DIM traverser_count description="number of traversers currently in the maze, including any branches or clones; current value unspecified"
DIM traverser_positions description="current cell coordinates of each traverser, including branches; current values unspecified"
DIM traverser_motion_states description="whether each traverser, including branches, is moving or idle; current values unspecified"
DIM traverser_algorithms description="navigation algorithm assigned to each traverser for exploring an unknown maze; some include branching search; current values unspecified"
DIM traverser_map_knowledge description="portion of the maze known to each traverser; branching traversers synchronize via shared visited memory; current values start empty and update through exploration"
DIM traverser_branching_ability description="whether each traverser can perform branching search by duplicating itself; current values unspecified"
DIM branching_traverser_branches description="active branches or clones for each branching-capable traverser; current values unspecified"
DIM branch_shared_visited_memory description="global record of maze cells visited by branching traverser branches; current value starts empty and updates as they explore"
